subject: Urgent assistance required
body:
Hi Esther,
I'm Amin from Avicenna.
I hope you have a great day and a path full of happy wonders ahead of you.
I'm sorry that you ran into issues with your Avicenna account.
As for 33eseah@gmail.com not registering, you have already used this email as a test participant in study 3451. You have the following options:

1- Change the email address you used for your participant account:
- Sign in to Avicenna (https://avicennaresearch.com/) using 33eseah@gmail.com email address
- Click on settings > Account information and under the "Email address" click on change. Now you can change that email address to free up the 33eseah@gmail.com email address. (You can add a "." (a dot) somewhere in your email address, like: 33e.seah@gmail.com or anywhere else that you will).

2- You can delete your account as a participant and sign up again, but it will take 14 days which I think doesn't work for your current situation.

3- (Quickest way) add a "." (a dot) somewhere in your email address, like: 33e.seah@gmail.com or anywhere else that you will and use this new email address to register as a researcher. The drawback of this method is that YOU HAVE TO REMEMBER WHERE YOU PUT THE DOT TO BE ABLE TO SIGN BACK IN LATER AS THE RESEARCHER.

Please use any of the methods suggested above and if it didn't work, let me know. I'm here for you and we will get it fixed before you leave the university.

Best regards,
Amin
